name: Small Molecule Cardiotoxicity Feature Representation Benchmark
description: Systematic comparison of small-molecule feature representations for predicting cardiotoxicity targets (hERG, Nav1.5, Cav1.2) using common evaluation protocols.
reputation: Niche benchmark within cheminformatics for representation comparisons; modest adoption by drug-discovery researchers benchmarking small-molecule cardiotoxicity predictors.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; multiple small/imbalanced target datasets (hERG, Nav1.5, Cav1.2) with risk of data leakage/compound overlap between splits; performance sensitive to descriptor choice and hyperparameter tuning.
